'''Tyler Christopher Herro''' (born January 20, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]].

==High school career==
Herro attended Whitnall High School in Greenfield, Wisconsin.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://247sports.com/Player/Tyler-Herro-85253/ |title = Tyler Herro, Kentucky Wildcats, Shooting Guard}}</ref> During Herro's senior year in high school, he averaged 32.9 points, 7.4 rebounds, 3.6 assists, and 3.3 steals per game. Throughout that year, he also shot better than 50 percent from the floor and 43.5 percent from the three-point line. Throughout his entire high school career, Herro tallied over two thousand points.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://ukathletics.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=6788 |title = Tyler Herro - Men's Basketball}}</ref> Herro originally committed to the [[University of Wisconsin]] on September 12, 2016. Nearly a year later, Herro de-committed from Wisconsin.<ref>{{cite web |last = Page | first = Fletcher | title=How Tyler Herro went from a Wisconsin commit to Kentucky-bound in 28 days|url=https://usatodayhss.com/2017/how-tyler-herro-went-from-a-wisconsin-commit-to-kentucky-bound-in-28-days |work=[[USA Today]]|accessdate=March 4, 2019|date=November 29, 2017}}</ref>

On November 14, 2017, Herro committed to play college basketball at the [[University of Kentucky]].

==College career==
On February 27, 2019, Herro scored a career high 29 points in a 70–66 win over [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Clay|first=John|title=Kentucky's Tyler Herro has career night in win over Arkansas|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-basketball-men/article226849959.html|work=Kentucky Sports|accessdate=March 4, 2019|date=February 27, 2019}}</ref> On April 12, 2019, Herro declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]], hiring an agent and thus forgoing his final three years of college eligibility. He is listed as a mid-first-round selection in most mock drafts. <ref>{{Cite web | url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2019/04/12/tyler-herro-declares-for-nba-draft/ |title = Tyler Herro declares for NBA draft|date = April 12, 2019}}</ref>.
